missing_external_facts: the wizardofodds.com host the feed is published to
the remote directory or object prefix the feed is served from
the transport protocol that host accepts (FTPS, SFTP, an HTTPS API or an object store)
the credential or secret names that transport authenticates with
a staging or canary destination on that host, separate from the live feed
the public URL or path the published rows appear at
note: live is null because every fact needed to describe it is external to this repository, and inventing any of them would produce a publisher that looks configured and writes nowhere real. The publisher refuses live mode while this is null, naming the missing facts. canary.root is null for a narrower reason: the canary root is a scratch location the operator names per run with --destination-root, so committing one would be a destination this repository asserted without being told.
